faq_a1: A decentralized file indexer built on TON Storage. We don't host any files — we only index Bag IDs shared by the community.
faq_a2: A unique 64-character hexadecimal identifier that points to a collection of files stored on the TON Storage network.
faq_a3: Copy the Bag ID and open it with a TON Storage client like
faq_q4: How do I add a bag?
faq_a4: Click “+ Add Bag”, connect your wallet on mainnet, enter a Bag ID, an optional title and a category. New publications use v3; v2 remains read only.
faq_a5: The amount is calculated from the contract’s funding requirements. It covers network fees and a storage reserve; unused surplus is refunded automatically. Wallet fees are additional.
faq_q6: How to access via TON network?
faq_a6: Use a TON-compatible browser or proxy to access piracy.ton directly on the TON network.
